question: Keeping current frequency-selected expert identities unchanged, does allowing protection only when its minimum current-call group count equals ordinary execution preserve transfer savings while improving complete requests?
basis: Full frequency late retention saved 2.395% payload but added 12.264% groups without stable request benefit. Structural reanalysis found nonempty opportunities with no extra current-call groups; no counterfactual latency or future cache outcome inferred.
workload: Same3 documents P32/P32/P128, outputs16/16/8; inject new request after4 old outputs; release chunk8 only after both old requests complete
intervention: Guard compares gP=max(1,ceil((|A|-|P intersection C|)/(K-|P intersection C|))) with g0=ceil(|A|/K), using only the actual current layer A/C and original frequency P. If unequal, actual P is empty. No change to selected candidate identities, precision, cache cap or kernel; each policy independently evolves future state.
reset: Existing drained pager metadata reset plus same five warmups. Each measured episode is drained before all its and warmup records/events are written/released. Allocations/KV free queue preserved, KV contents not compared.
primary: Complete capture wall including in-window observations plus old per-request max-ITL/completion and new TTFT/completion; preserve the full tradeoff, no selected scalar SLO.

accounting.per_repeat: From before GPU preflight/reset through all warmups, requests, snapshots/raw writes and flush/decref. Excludes its own cycle_progress write and shared final tail; both are covered by whole engine cycle/process.
accounting.engine: Post-init cycle through shutdown, with own final marker covered by parent process wall. Mixed-policy engine totals are total cost, not attributable arm speedups. Tar/readback outside these clocks.
accounting.gc: Observed callback intervals only; observer closes before event export/shutdown. Never subtract GC or sum overlapping CUDA/CPU spans.

comparison: Each consecutive three-episode block includes all arms; report guard versus none, guard versus full frequency, and full frequency versus none in every block (12 comparisons). Preserve four dependent repeats per arm, per-engine summaries and order. No sample maximum is a population noise bound.
integrity: All measurement/warmup requests retained; consecutive global call IDs across flushes; row/request/time joins; source/GPU boundary checks; actual resources and common logical pre-action state. Compare trace equality within mode, not across distinct policies.
qualification: One standalone frequency/late/no_extra_groups episode with verify-kernel, before performance. Verify the first actually applied retained mixed layer against full-expert computation from the same layer input/top-k; a rejected guard call cannot satisfy qualification. Bounded finite/allclose validation, not bitwise full trajectory equality or task quality. Common warmups are retained and qualification timing is excluded from performance comparisons.
stop: Foreign GPU process/query failure, incomplete requests or corrupt evidence abort and retain files. No automatic retry or additional outcome-selected runs.
interpretation: If the guard actually limits its current-state groups and consistently improves requests across both engines and block orders without transferring delay to old requests, proceed to independent workload evaluation. If local groups/bytes improve but requests do not, narrow this mechanism cost model; keep the shared research problem OPEN. Sign changes or pre-action drift remain unresolved, not automatically noise.
ceiling: Two fresh engines, same three documents, four dependent performance episodes per arm, artificial cap24 native eager BF16 paging. No population significance, calibrated noise bound, production p99/SLO, task quality, generality or novelty claim.
cpu_checks: 13 grouping tests passed including current-state reconstruction of 6144 old calls with accept/reject, capacity, coverage and entry-miss-once checks; old default planner unchanged. Syntax, invalid CLI combinations, backward-compatible phase reader on 3072 prior measured calls and git diff --check passed.
